record.question: The temperature and pressure commonly used in an autoclave are:
record.explanation: Answer B: 121°C at 15 psi for 15–20 min. The printed conventional laboratory autoclave cycle is saturated steam at 121°C and about 15 psi above atmospheric pressure for 15–20 minutes. Valid cycle times depend on load, packaging, and sterilizer, so this is the familiar teaching cycle rather than a universal cycle. Reference: https://www.cdc.gov/infection-control/hcp/disinfection-sterilization/steam-sterilization.html. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
